sloka: अनन्तरं महाविप्रो गौतमः प्रत्यपूरयत् ।वसिष्ठो ऽपि महातेजा इन्द्रयज्ञमथाकरोत् ।। ७.५५.११ ॥
transliteration: anantaraṁ mahāvipro gautamaḥ pratyapūrayat ।vasiṣṭho 'pi mahātejā indrayajñamathākarot ।। 7.55.11 ॥

translations.english: Subsequently, the great brahmin Gautama fulfilled Nimi's request, while the greatly effulgent Vasishtha then performed Indra's sacrifice.
